e.title: insurance-scmoe
e.summary: 空间聚类 Mixture of Experts（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：联合频率-严重度空间 MoE
e.summary_en: Spatially clustered MoE (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): joint frequency-severity spatial mixture of experts
e.summary_hk: 空間聚類 Mixture of Experts（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：聯合頻率-嚴重度空間 MoE
e.body:
insurance-scmoe（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做空间聚类 Mixture of Experts（MoE）：联合频率-严重度的空间专家混合——不同地区由不同「专家」模型处理（空间分治）。对 RIAA：MoE 是「一个模型打天下」的替代——地区异质性大时分区建模（[[insurance-spatial]] 平滑 vs MoE 分治是两条路线）；与 [[insurance-frequency-severity]]（联合建模）、[[insurance-distributional]]（分布 GBM）配套；适合地域异质性强的车险/家财险；MoE 是 ML 的前沿架构（大模型中的稀疏激活）。

## 同类工具
[[insurance-sensitivity]]、[[insurance-spatial-conformal]]、[[lakeside-mutual]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_en:
insurance-scmoe (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) does spatially clustered Mixture of Experts (MoE): spatial experts for joint frequency-severity — different regions handled by different 'expert' models (spatial divide-and-conquer). For RIAA: MoE is an alternative to 'one model fits all' — regional heterogeneity suggests regional models ([[insurance-spatial]] smoothing vs MoE partitioning are two routes); pairs with [[insurance-frequency-severity]] (joint modelling) and [[insurance-distributional]] (distributional GBM); suits motor/home with strong regional heterogeneity; MoE is a frontier ML architecture (sparse activation in LLMs).

## Similar tools
[[insurance-sensitivity]]、[[insurance-spatial-conformal]]、[[lakeside-mutual]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
